# Shield of Faith (`spells:shield-of-faith`)
**Level 1 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** 60 feet
**Components:** V, S, M (a prayer scroll) | **Duration:** up to 10 minutes | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md)

A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.
